correctness.rationale: The proved pair-union covariance formula follows from survival indicators and inclusion-exclusion. Both explicit graphs have the same labeled bidegrees and eight edges, verified connected; exact subsets give variance differences -1/5 at k=2 and +1/5 at k=3. The attached enumeration exhausts all connected simple bipartite labeled graphs through eight vertices and compares all degree-class profiles in exact integers (70,479 graphs). It includes every relevant case, with one-vertex guilds handled analytically. Eight edges is the tree minimum for connected nine-vertex witnesses.

originality.rationale: The exact nine-vertex, eight-edge connected fixed-bidegree variance-reversal and complete no-reversal cutoff through eight vertices are absent from the relevant ecological simulation/analytic primary texts inspected and from accessible related mathematical records. The claims compare conditional variance at each fixed primary-survival count; they are not deductions from degree-only mean formulas or variance of robustness integrated across budgets. Historical priority remains provisional due to possible unindexed hypergraph-coverage literature.
residual_risks: Unindexed combinatorial hypergraph-coverage, network-reliability or ecological null-model literature may contain an equivalent sharp nine-vertex example or stronger theorem.
published-finding corpus semantic search results and accessible historical records are not a certificate of global priority.

This is a sharply scoped idealized one-step stochastic ecology model, not an empirical prediction or general cascading-extinction theorem.

value.rationale: A precise ecological-network limit to degree-based uncertainty summaries: two minimally connected networks with all individual species degrees and all expected surviving-richness values fixed can exhibit opposite conditional richness-variance rankings at different surviving-species budgets. The exact first order and link count are a naturally motivated non-arbitrary sharp boundary and a useful small benchmark for robustness model validation; no unjustified real-world consequence is claimed.
